universe.title: Star Fleet Battles Universe
universe.description: Star Fleet Battles is set in the Alpha Quadrant of the Star Trek universe, focusing on large-scale space combat between the major powers: the United Federation of Planets, the Klingon Empire, the Romulan Star Empire, and various other factions. The game takes place during the era of the original Star Trek series and films.
source_material: Star Fleet Battles by Amarillo Design Bureau (1979-present)
Star Trek original series and films

federation.name: United Federation of Planets
federation.description: A democratic interstellar federation of planetary governments united under a single central government. The Federation is dedicated to peace, exploration, scientific discovery, and the betterment of all sentient life.

core_values: The Prime Directive - non-interference with developing civilizations
Protection of member worlds and neutral systems

prime_directive.description: General Order 1 prohibits Starfleet from interfering with the normal social development of alien civilizations, particularly pre-warp societies.
exceptions: When a greater threat endangers both parties
When the civilization has already achieved warp capability

starfleet.description: The exploratory and defensive service of the Federation. Starfleet operates starships for exploration, diplomacy, scientific research, and defense.

member_worlds: Many others across the Alpha Quadrant

klingon_empire.name: Klingon Empire
klingon_empire.description: A warrior culture that values honor, strength, and martial prowess above all else. The Klingon Empire is a collection of worlds united under the Klingon High Council, with a society built on military achievement and personal honor.

honor_code.description: Honor is the highest value in Klingon society. Dishonor is the greatest shame, worse than death.
principles: Defend the Empire and its interests
Die with honor rather than live in shame

warrior_traditions: Bat'leth combat - the traditional Klingon weapon
Kahs - formal duels to settle disputes
Rites of Passage - proving one's worth through combat
Death Duels - formal combat to the death for matters of honor

society.houses: Noble houses compete for power and influence
society.family: Family honor is paramount; dishonor affects the entire family
society.food: Klingon cuisine is known for being hearty and unusual (e.g., gagh - live worm)

klingon_defense_force.description: The military arm of the Klingon Empire, responsible for defending Klingon space and expanding imperial influence.

notable_figures.name: Chancellor Gorkon
notable_figures.role: Reformist Chancellor who sought peace with the Federation
notable_figures.fate: Assassinated by rogue elements within the Empire

notable_figures.name: General Chang
notable_figures.role: Military leader who opposed peace with the Federation
notable_figures.role_description: Led coup against Gorkon's peace efforts

notable_figures.name: Worf
notable_figures.role: First Klingon to serve in Starfleet
notable_figures.significance: Bridge between Klingon and Federation cultures

romulan_star_empire.name: Romulan Star Empire
romulan_star_empire.description: A secretive and powerful empire descended from Vulcans who rejected the logical path of their ancestors. The Romulans are masters of deception, espionage, and cloaking technology.

government.leadership: The Praetor and the Tal Shiar

history.founding: Approximately 1800 years before the 23rd century, Vulcans exiled for emotional extremism founded the Romulan Star Empire.
history.split_from_vulcan: The Romulans split from Vulcan society, embracing emotion and passion while maintaining Vulcan logic and discipline.
key_events: Founding of the Romulan Star Empire
Khitomer Accords - peace with the Federation
Dominion War alliance with the Federation

tal_shiar.description: The intelligence and security service of the Romulan Star Empire. The Tal Shiar is feared throughout the quadrant for its ruthless methods and extensive spy network.

romulan_starfleet.description: The military arm of the Romulan Star Empire, known for its use of cloaking devices and plasma torpedoes.

cloaking_device.description: Technology that renders ships invisible to sensors and visual observation. A closely guarded secret.
limitations: Cannot fire weapons while cloaked (without decloaking)

plasma_torpedoes.description: Energy-based torpedoes that are more powerful than photon torpedoes but harder to produce.

tholians.name: Tholian Assembly
tholians.description: An insectoid species that controls the Tholian Web, a vast network of fiber filaments spanning thousands of light-years. The Tholians are isolationist and defensive.

technology.fiber_weapons: Can create webs to trap and immobilize starships
technology.temperature_manipulation: Can lower temperature to absolute zero in targeted areas

gorn.name: Gorn
gorn.description: A reptilian species known for their durability and aggressive nature. The Gorn are solitary hunters who value strength and survival.

molor.name: Molor
molor.description: A minor power in the SFB universe, known for their unique ship designs and trade networks.

son'a.name: Son'a
son'a.description: A powerful faction that controls the Denobula system and surrounding space. The Son'a are known for their advanced technology and ruthless methods.

notable_conflicts.name: Klingon-Federation Border Wars
notable_conflicts.description: A series of conflicts along the Federation-Klingon border, including the Battle of the Kobayashi Maru (a famous training scenario).
notable_conflicts.significance: Defined the relationship between the two powers and led to the Khitomer Accords

notable_conflicts.name: Romulan-Federation Tensions
notable_conflicts.description: Cold war-style tensions between the Federation and Romulan Star Empire, with proxy conflicts and espionage.
notable_conflicts.significance: Led to the Neutral Zone agreement and ongoing diplomatic efforts

notable_conflicts.name: Khitomer Accords
notable_conflicts.description: Peace treaty between the Federation and Klingon Empire, negotiated by Chancellor Gorkon and Spock.
notable_conflicts.significance: Major shift in Alpha Quadrant politics, undermined by rogue elements

notable_conflicts.name: Tholian Web Conflicts
notable_conflicts.description: Incidents where ships entered the Tholian Web without permission, leading to confrontations.
notable_conflicts.significance: Established the Tholian Web as restricted space

key_locations.name: Earth
key_locations.description: Capital of the Federation, home to Starfleet Headquarters and the Federation Council.
key_locations.significance: Political and military center of the Federation

key_locations.name: Qo'noS
key_locations.description: Capital of the Klingon Empire, a harsh world with a warrior culture.
key_locations.significance: Political and military center of the Klingon Empire

key_locations.name: Romulus
key_locations.description: Capital of the Romulan Star Empire, located in the Beta Quadrant.
key_locations.significance: Political and military center of the Romulan Star Empire

key_locations.name: Khitomer
key_locations.description: Mining colony where the Khitomer Accords were signed.

key_locations.name: Neutral Zone
key_locations.description: Buffer zone between Federation and Romulan space, established by treaty.
key_locations.significance: Demilitarized zone, violation considered act of war

key_locations.name: Tholian Web
key_locations.description: Vast network of fiber filaments controlled by the Tholians.
key_locations.significance: Restricted space, entry without permission leads to conflict

key_locations.name: Babel
key_locations.description: Diplomatic station where the Federation Council meets.

warp_drive.description: Faster-than-light propulsion system that enables interstellar travel.

levels.warp_4: 16 times light speed (cruising speed for most ships)
levels.warp_6: 216 times light speed (cruising speed for Constitution-class)

shields.description: Energy barriers that protect ships from weapons fire.

types.deflector_shields: Primary protection, can be directed to specific arcs
types.inertial_dampeners: Reduce effects of acceleration and deceleration

weapons.phasers: Energy weapons that can be set to stun or kill
weapons.photon_torpedoes: Antimatter warheads that explode on impact
weapons.disruptors: Klingon energy weapons that damage shields and hull
weapons.quantum_torpedoes: More powerful variant of photon torpedoes
